text:
marie: quick design question — I'm iterating on the threshold card for Alerting/SLO config. Two options in Figma: compact horizontal card (metric | op | value | preview) vs vertical stacked rows. compact saves space but feels dense on keyboard focus :thinking: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/alerts-ui

tess: compact is nice for the dashboard list but i'm worried about discoverability when you have multiple conditions. stacked rows are clearer, esp for nested suppression rules.

sam: accessibility nit — the compact option relies on color to indicate severity and a tiny icon. We need text labels or at least aria-labels on icons. Also ensure 4.5:1 contrast on that red/yellow.

jordan: also the operator dropdown should be keyboard reachable without opening a weird popup. current prototype traps focus inside the operator menu. keyboard flow should be: metric -> operator -> value -> preview -> add condition.

marie: good call. i put a small aria example on the figma comments:

```
<button aria-label="operator: greater than" aria-expanded="false">></button>
```

lee: copy tweak: right now the preview button says `Send preview` which is vague. suggest `Send test notification to <channel>` or `Preview notification payload` depending on intent. for SLO alerts we often want a dry run option that doesn't increment incident counters.

sam: +1 on the copy. Also we should show what the notification will contain inline. small modal with header: `Preview: Slack — #ops-oncall` and payload snippet. Include attribution for which rule triggered.

marie: for suppression UI — suggestion: collapse schedule into a pill with hover tooltip showing rule details, and a small conflict badge if the suppression overlaps with an escalation window. Example: `Suppression: 03:00-05:00 (timezone: UTC) · conflicts with: Oncall Rotation`.

tess: visual hierarchy question: should threshold value be primary weight? users scan for thresholds first. i'd make the numeric value bold and put unit right after, operator smaller.

jordan: backend note — when previewing, use a synth event generator that mimics KV cache state and token counts so previews reflect actual payload sizes. not critical for this design thread but FYI.

marie: accessibility check: color-only chips (Active/Muted) -> add icon + text; focus ring should be 3px and visible on high-contrast themes. Also add `aria-live` for the preview result toast.

lee: small QA flow: after design update, can we get a quick keyboard-only walkthrough? i'll try on mac VoiceOver too.

marie: will update figma with the stacked-row preferred variant plus the compact as a dense option. i'll change copy to `Notify if value remains >= 90 for 5 minutes` vs current `Notify when >=90 for 5m`.

tess: love that copy — much clearer.

alerts-bot: deployment scheduled: alerts-ui/preview -> staging at 2026-03-22T16:00Z

marie: perfect, i'll push the figma comments and tag @sam @jordan for the keyboard follow-up. thanks all :sparkles:
